notes.title: Guildford Castle VR Patch 3
notes.content:
[b]Fixed startup issues for some some users:[/b]

[list]
[*]Intro sequence now starts playing immediately on launch for Steam VR headset users.  
[/list]

[b]Graphics settings menu:[/b]

[list]
[*]Removed draw distance setting from the menu.  On certain settings, this was causing objects to disappear too early.
[/list]
[b]
Minor visual fixes:[/b]

[list]
[*]Removed text actor for St Thomas's Hospital in historic environment.
[*]Corrected orientation of Union Jack flag on the modern castle.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42079540/41ebdd25a23e024750a74ffad11c6226286cc5f8.png[/img]

notes.title: Guildford Castle VR Patch 2
notes.content:
[b]Teleportation now works in the following areas:[/b]

[list]
[*]Modern day basement of the keep
[*]Smaller rooms on the first floor of the modern day keep
[*]12th century reconstruction of the Main Chamber
[*]Top of the keep in 14th century Guildford 
[*]The entire inner bailey/historical palace area 
[/list]

[b]Collision have been improved in the following areas:[/b]

[list]
[*]Tunnel in modern Guildford
[*]Fixed a number of collision glitches around the wider 14th century environment
[/list]

[b]Visual improvements:
[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed visual glitches around the modern day tunnel area 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42079540/ddfcc00b07c91a9c792409309cf34ab788ef89f2.png[/img]

notes.title: Guildford Castle VR Patch 1
notes.content: Double audio playing on the hotspot "Welcome to Medieval Guildford" in the historical level fixed.
